title: Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) Observation Day Count
content:
The observation day count of a self-pay Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) observation stay follows the stay. The plain day difference is the difference in days between the service start date and the service end date; the observation hours are the total units of the account's observation-hour charge lines (revenue code 0762).

**Clause.** For a stay whose service end date is after its service start date, on an account carrying an emergency department level charge line (revenue code 0450), whose observation hours exceed 24 times the plain day difference, the observation days are the observation hours divided by 24 and rounded up to a whole day. For a stay whose service end date is recorded and equals its service start date and that carries observation hours, the observation days are 1. Otherwise they stay at the plain day difference.

## Methods by stay

| Stay | Emergency department level line | Observation hours | Observation days |
|---|---|---|---|
| ends after it starts | yes | more than 24 times the plain day difference | hours divided by 24, rounded up to a whole day |
| ends after it starts | yes | 24 times the plain day difference or fewer | plain day difference |
| ends after it starts | no | any | plain day difference |
| ends the day it starts (end date recorded) | either | above 0 | 1 |

## Worked cases (hypothetical stays)

- Start 1 March, end 3 March (plain difference 2), level line on the account, 53 observation hours: 53 exceeds 48, and 53 divided by 24 is about 2.21, rounded up to 3 days.
- The same stay with exactly 48 hours: 48 does not exceed 48, so 2 days.
- The same 53-hour stay with no level line: 2 days.
- Start and end both 5 March, 10 observation hours: 1 day.
